'''Nolo''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] employed by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] around the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

==Biography==
At some point in his career, Nolo became acquainted with mercenary [[Vana Sage]]. Sage would later go to work alone. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the mercenary group Nolo belonged to was hired by the Trade Federation to kidnap [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Queen Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The group was unable to capture the Queen. Soon after their failure, Nolo led a group of mercenaries sent by the Federation after a new target: Vana Sage. Nolo exchanged words with Vana, but showed no hesitation in attacking her. Nolo failed to kill Sage, and she [[Skirmish at Eos|destroyed]] all the starfighters he brought with him, including himself.

==Skills and abilities==
Nolo was a pilot. He flew a [[Dianoga-class assault starfighter|''Dianoga'' starfighter]] in his fight against Vana Sage.

==Behind the scenes==
Nolo appears on one level of the video game [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]. Destroying his ship is not necessary to beat the level, but it is required for a gold medal on that level.
